summary: Independent review passes the admitted raw-report reuse and application-budget slice on frozen bytes. This is not full W32, a net performance improvement, native capacity, customer acceptance or release approval.

criteria.evidence: Inspected the actual report implementation and grouped fixture: policy-independent exposures and slot counts are computed once; each policy receives a detached full StatsState. Original input order, first-ID-wins attribution, repeated credits, later duplicate-policy-name overwrite, sorted outputs and input immutability remain. The independent fixed command passed; the retained lead comparison establishes exact full-JSON parity for all eight outputs per size at 2,000 and 10,000 decisions.

Actual pure builder, strict raw loader, hourly bridge and authenticated POST enforce the admitted bounds: 50,000 records per stream, six total policies, 800 shared objects, 16 MiB per object and combined raw text, 1,000,000 estimated work, 16,384 projected cells, component/key bounds, 8 MiB output and 64 KiB streamed POST body. Both raw streams are listed into a shared bounded key cache before object reads; cursor/traversal bounds prevent indefinite listing. Native size prechecks and actual UTF-8 checks, cached nested-map projection/parent closure, sanitized no-store 400/413 and refusal before canonical put were inspected. Existing grouped cases cover exact boundaries, early cancellation, no partial publication, real JWT/tenant routing, legacy POST zero omission and generic loadDay behavior.

Reviewed the actual five forward/reverse deltas, final source, all three new fixture groups and six retained selections, kit limits, complete worker history and both measurements. The single independent final-byte invocation passed 9 with 25 unselected. Reused the final compiler/lint/whitespace capture and lead measurement without rerunning either. All 46 artifact pins, 30 protected pins, five bidirectional reconstructions and the current task contract match before and after execution.

static_reuse.qualification: Final worker captures inspected and bound to the frozen source; no static replay.

retained_attempt.qualification: Executed candidate source reconstructed from retained baseline and delta; regression prompted allocation optimizations without loosening budgets. Superseded, not hidden.

measurement_reuse.qualification: Local Node v22.15.0/linux x64, actual before/current modules bundled in memory, low-cardinality synthetic data, one warmup pair and three alternating measured pairs. Final timings retain modest overhead, not a total speedup or native/SLO claim. The generic record wording 'excludes serialization' is overbroad: the actual timer includes all buildReport work, including admission/full-row JSON and internal rawReportJson output-limit serialization; only the external comparison JSON.stringify after elapsed is excluded.

retained_failures_and_qualifications: The initial five-policy cap was corrected to six total policies in plan-r2 before any runtime, preserving the existing four-preset-plus-custom UI flow; original admission history remains.
Retained a no-write kit patch-context failure. Initial static session 14392/8b6f44 exited 2 on a fixture mock signature and required TextDecoder ignoreBOM options; lint/whitespace were not reached.

Worker runtime candidates 88998/9b0a08, 28022/9ef385 and 92806/f7156b passed but were superseded by compatibility corrections and the measured-regression optimization. Static 72428/5ae75f and the first STOP were likewise superseded. Final runtime 22936/975063 and static 1367/251dfd apply to final STOP 2026-09-12T21:33:03.194Z.
Both passing-output measurements and the initial substantial regression remain. No measurement or source history was rewritten to manufacture a speedup.
limitations: Raw-report application admission only: estimates are not native instruction, memory or provider-capacity guarantees. Pure caller inputs already exist; full-row and final-output serialization allocate before their resulting size can be checked. Text-only R2 adapters lack native preallocation prevention; stream/native-size paths are stronger.
Aggregate construction, saved GET/window reports, lightweight summaries, tombstone/config/auth loading, full W32 model/envelope work and customer operating ranges remain outside this slice.

Existing first-ID and duplicate-policy-name semantics, canonical-versus-canonical races, swallowed canonical persistence acknowledgements and historical repair limitations are preserved, not fixed. W33 custom-report isolation and retained W30/W21 checks remain intact.
No deployed/native/HTTP load benchmark, statistical acceptance, cloud operation, customer-data exercise, new infrastructure, full-package closure or release approval.
